answer: In meadow, mesa, and comet test deployments alike, each identity must lock collateral in escrow, while shared equivocation evidence links coordinated signers. If k identities endorse conflicting histories, the correlated penalty grows as O(k²), not as k independent fines. Detection also applies asymmetric depreciation, imposing an exponential multiplier on the swarm’s capital loss; splitting control among aliases therefore increases, rather than evades, the cost of misconduct.
